note: Workbook demonstration data, not a live ERP position. Delist/grow classification, GMROI, tail share and capital freed are computed live from ENGINE/ENGINE_STORE/SKU_Master (chain-wide quartiles), not read from the A6 sheet's own B:F cells, which a prior audit found to hold stale hardcoded values. Contribution/day is the one column that audit did not flag, and reconciles exactly.

formulas.f01-ads-per-store: base_ads * seasonality * store_size * (1 + demand_lever / 100) * IF(AND(promo_eligible = "Y", promo_lever > 0), 1 + (promo_lever / 100) * 1.3 * (1 - promo_depth), 1)
formulas.f05-rop: ROUND(ads * (MAX(1, lead_time_days + lead_time_adjust) + MAX(0, safety_days + safety_adjust)))
formulas.f06-maximum-inventory: ROUND(ads * (MAX(1, lead_time_days + lead_time_adjust) + MAX(0, safety_days + safety_adjust) + 4))
formulas.f07-inventory-state: IF(position < rop * 0.6, "Stockout", IF(position < rop, "Low", IF(AND(perishable = "Y", days_of_supply > shelf_life_days), "Expiry", IF(AND(perishable = "N", days_of_supply > 15), "Overstock", IF(AND(velocity < 1, days_of_supply > 10), "Slow-mover", "Healthy")))))
